in_marathi.name: Kirtida
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Love
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kirtida हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Kirtida is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Kirtidah', which means 'one who delights the heart'. In Hindu mythology, Kirtida is an epithet of Radha, the consort of Lord Krishna. Radha is known for her supreme love and devotion towards Krishna. The name is a symbol of love, devotion, and the power of the heart.
